delivery_scope: Source-only: FinMind monthly revenue / quarterly statement / daily valuation datasets, statutory availability, dev refresh step, bounded deploy admission, and pool admission loading of every referenced governed feature dataset. No hosted deployment, no live FinMind fetch, no live capital.

tw_financial_statement.available_time: Q1 May 15, Q2 Aug 14, Q3 Nov 14, annual report (Q4) Mar 31 of next year (explicit date, correct in leap years)

tw_valuation_bwibbu.history: latest 5 days plus one rotating 60-day page per daily run, fetched as two separate bounded windows (never the span between); two years complete within 13 daily runs; <=~46 rows per symbol

point_in_time.derived_fields: revenue yoy/mom use only comparison months whose own statutory availability is not later; otherwise null
point_in_time.value_revision: provider_latest_revision_not_first_release (stated on every row and record metadata)
point_in_time.catalogue: feature_catalogue.statutory_available_date/time; observations_from_row and read_feature_series enforce the floor; official taiwan_official Q4 lag replaced by statutory deadline

deploy_admission: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh and terminal verifier admit exactly the three added datasets; any other still rejected (tests in scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py)

pool_admission.change: services/persona/pool_dataset_authority.py loads every governed non-price dataset a candidate factor_rule_v1 references through the real source dataset authority and attaches point-in-time observations as features_by_instrument[instrument][dataset][field]; pool_autonomy_cycle passes the registry strategy_artifact to the loader. Screened rules (strategy_logic.screen) additionally receive candidate_pool_market.v1 from the source owner feed (fetch_candidate_pool_market) and fail closed if the market is unavailable or no market symbol carries a referenced dataset.field. Feature dataset-versions are materialized under <output_root>/feature-datasets/<dataset>, so the canonical-dataset-version pointer sync (newest dataset-version-*.json in output_root) can never be repointed at a feature dataset.
pool_admission.fail_closed: unconfigured connector, rejected source authority, canonical-path override, or no observations for a referenced dataset.field raise AuthorityValidationError 'feature dataset coverage missing: ...', recorded in the cycle receipt reason governed_dataset_unavailable:<type>: <message>
pool_admission.config: PERSONA_POOL_FEATURE_CONNECTOR_IDS JSON map dataset -> connector id (must be set in the hosted persona env; not set by this task)
pool_admission.limits: Screened-rule market is fetched from the existing source-ingest candidate-pool-market route; tests fake only that owner HTTP response (built from authority-loaded bars and real-authority revenue observations). Screened history stays survivorship_limited unless the market attests delisted/suspended coverage (unchanged gate). The published fixture has only two revenue months with yoy, so the four-observation z-score window is shown to refuse for insufficient history and a shortened signal completes the replay. Research retrain / card-production loaders (services/research/main.py, card_production_wiring.py) read explicit price-only dataset paths, were not changed, and a rule referencing non-price datasets there still fails closed in the factor-rule evaluator for missing inputs.
